beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Paul wrote that when God's Spirit lives in a person, a harvest grows — not crops, but character.

timing.text: Paul wrote that when God's Spirit lives in a person, a harvest grows — not crops, but character.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

timing.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then peace — the kind that doesn't depend on circumstances.

timing.text: Then peace — the kind that doesn't depend on circumstances.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Longsuffering next — patience that doesn't quit. Then gentleness, and goodness, and faith that holds.

timing.text: Longsuffering next — patience that doesn't quit.
Then gentleness, and goodness, and faith that holds.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Meekness, and temperance — self-control that masters the storms inside.

timing.text: Meekness, and temperance — self-control that masters the storms inside.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And no law anywhere forbids any of it. These are the things that can't be overdone.

timing.text: And no law anywhere forbids any of it.
These are the things that can't be overdone.

card.text: This fruit isn't grown by strain. Ask the Spirit — and let it ripen in you.
